name: moderation
title: Moderation
summary: People report content and other users, block anyone, and staff work a review queue; text is filtered before it is posted.

env.name: MODERATION_BLOCKED_TERMS
env.doc: Comma-separated words or phrases refused before posting; matching ignores case, accents and common letter swaps (h3llo).

env.name: MODERATION_PROVIDER
env.doc: Extra AI check before posting: none or openai. A provider outage lets text through and logs the error.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.doc: OpenAI API key; required when MODERATION_PROVIDER=openai (the moderation endpoint is free).

env.name: MODERATION_AUTOHIDE_REPORTS
env.doc: Hide content once this many different people report it, until staff review it; 0 turns auto-hide off.

env.name: MODERATION_NOTIFY_REPORTER
env.doc: Tell reporters when staff close their report (generic wording, no details about the action).

stitch: Write the community rules the filter and the queue enforce, link them from the Terms, and put the reasons in your own words if needed.
Decide MODERATION_AUTOHIDE_REPORTS for launch (3 is a common start for a public feed; 0 for small private groups).
Name who works the queue and how they hear about new cases (admin:live is realtime; add an email or chat alert if nobody watches the console). Target: every case closed within 24 hours.
Fill MODERATION_BLOCKED_TERMS for your audience and language; set MODERATION_PROVIDER=openai for public UGC.
Add ReportDialog/BlockButton (web and mobile src/features/moderation) wherever a person or their content appears that no feature already covers (profiles, avatars, member lists).
